♐ The Sagittarius Cloth. [UTILITY]

Cloth Passive — The Bow

Your Cloth includes a bow that uses your unarmed proficiency and can never be disarmed or destroyed.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice things beyond 100 feet, and your Speed increases by 10 feet.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Golden Arrow]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Chiron's Light Impulse]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Infinity Break]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Aiolos's Wings]

Ascendant Boon — Atomic Thunderbolt [UTILITY]

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Golden Arrow]'s range increment becomes one mile. It ignores all cover, concealment, and the hidden and undetected conditions, and can hit any creature whose location you can name without line of sight.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Sagittarius)]

Zenith Boon — Atomic Thunderbolt (Zenith) [UTILITY]

As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute Golden Arrow reaches any named creature within a mile through any barrier short of a planar boundary and deals +8 dice.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Sagittarius)]
